description: Verify adopted dialog and form rhythm in actual route consumers (#667; REQ-016, REQ-017, REQ-018; C40, C41, C43, C05, C42, C47, C44, C57, C58, C59; P01-P03; AC-C40-01, AC-C41-01, AC-C43-01, AC-R016-01..03, AC-C05-01, AC-C42-01, AC-C47-01, AC-R017-01..03, AC-C44-01, AC-C57-01, AC-C58-01, AC-C59-01, AC-R018-01..04; completion owner of JOURNEY-016, JOURNEY-017, JOURNEY-018). check-01 drives the actual route consumers over one contained synthetic account (ENTRY-016/017/018: /workout, /summary, Home's rest-day entry and /review) and the accepted gallery states (reference eded158cfd928d382c9a9409e2c372270312741d: anchor, other-lift, timed-movement, distance-movement, extra-set, set-correction, superset, circuit-round, circuit-movement, movement-note, workout-feedback, rest-day, emom, amrap, for_time, ladder, ladder-long, plus urgency). It measures real Chromium geometry at 320x568, 390x844 and 1280x800: the framed icon-only Close log X's visible top on the title's visible top (paint to paint, wrapped titles and Workout feedback included), exactly the Balanced backdrop with a filter-free foreground, direct per-text AA contrast in clear, vapour, signal and mono, an inert screen while rest and block clocks keep counting, drafts and focus kept through X, Escape and reopen; card peer gaps and complete movement groups set the movement gap apart, choice legends at the field gap, the ladder heading gap kept and its count separated, the removed helper paragraph absent with performed/unrecorded writes intact; one stationary frame filling the visible viewport (on-screen keyboard included) for long forms and content height for short ones, the scroller on the inner border with a control painted to it mid-scroll, no scrollbar or sideways overflow, touch, wheel and keyboard reaching the last control, no container outline on open, reopen or a blank tap, and focus brackets painted inside the log. Delivered-revision images and JSON metadata are attached to every case. Every declared case must execute and pass.

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-041 --check check-01 -- npx playwright test e2e/refinement/task-041.spec.ts --project=mobile
